senses.gloss: m. (tragos, τράγος) a mess of groats of wheat, barley &c., groats used for a mess.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 37a">Ber. 37ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="I00711"><he>טרגיס</he></cite> (Ms. F. <he>טריגוס</he>); <cite ref="Berakhot 37a">Ib.</cite> Ms. M. (missing in ed.) <cite ref="I00706"><he>טרגוס</he></cite>, also <he>טירגוס</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 20, 30).
M. Kat. 13ᵇ טרגיס חדא לתלתא (Ms. M. also טירגיס) it is called tragos, when each grain is broken in three parts, v. חֶילְקָא II.
